parsed.explanation: For n=2, the proposed Liu pieces are 2/5, 2/5, 1/5. Xiang can use one cut to bisect the 1/5 piece, producing sorted lengths 2/5, 2/5, 1/10, 1/10. Liu receives the odd-ranked pieces, totaling 1/2<3/5. Thus the asserted extension beyond splitting every big piece once is false. No universal lower-bound argument for the correct 1:2:4 construction appears elsewhere; a different all-n lemma and strategy are required.
